messages.content: 請告訴我美國的一些主要機場。

function.name: distance_calculate

message.reasoning: The user asks: "請告訴我美國的一些主要機場。" (Please tell me some major airports in the United States.) They want a list of major US airports. We can provide a list. No tool needed. Just answer.
